title: Relationship
wikitext:
[[Image:RelationshipBack.png|right|160px]]

'''Relationship''' is a [[special]] card.  It first appeared in [[The Lurker at the Threshold]] expansion.

During setup of a game with more than one player, Relationship cards are dealt out. In a two player game, one card is drawn. In a game with three or more players, each player is dealt one card. Relationship cards describe a connection between two [[investigator]]s and the benefit they both gain from it. A cardholder's partner is the player to his left. If an investigator is ''[[devoured]]'', the Relationship cards he benefits from are discarded. New Relationship cards are ''not'' drawn when a new investigator comes into play.
